Added 2026-07-30 for the Glass sunken well. The ramp jumped 12 -> 15 and neither step worked: at 0.15 the light-glass sunken surface leaves ui.text.content.warning at 4.42:1 and ui.text.content.body-muted at 4.45:1, both short of 4.5, while 0.12 clears them but flattens the well more than the design wants. 0.14 is the shallowest wash that clears every gated pair on that surface.
